title: Festive Fare: Passionfruit Cream Parfait.
subtitle: Made to share – take a plate or dine in!
description: Make it an Australian festive season to remember with our collection of crowd-pleasing desserts. Made with fresh pineapple and passionfruit and layered with salted caramel, whipped cream and sugar-frosted nuts, this fruity finale is hard to resist.

steps.text: Toast almonds: Put the almonds in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Meanwhile, coarsely chop the macadamias. Halve the passionfruit and scoop the pulp into a bowl. Line an oven tray with baking paper.

Make sugared nuts: Put 55g (¼ cup) caster sugar and 60ml (¼ cup) water in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the sugar dissolves, then bring to the boil and cook, without stirring, for 2½ mins or until syrupy. Add the almonds and macadamias and cook, stirring, for 3-4 mins until the syrup crystallises. Remove from the heat. Pour onto the lined tray and cool completely. Wash and dry the pan.

Make caramel: Put 55g (¼ cup) caster sugar and 60ml (¼ cup) water in the clean pan over low heat. Stir until the sugar is dissolved, then bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium-high and cook, without stirring, for 8-10 mins until a golden caramel. Immediately remove from the heat, add 100ml cream and 20g butter and stir until combined (be careful, as the caramel may bubble and spit).

Make passionfruit cream: Return the caramel to medium-high heat and stir until smooth. Bring to the boil and cook, stirring, for a further 2 mins or until thickened and dark golden. Stir in a pinch of sea salt flakes. Transfer to a heatproof jug and cool slightly. Put the remaining chilled cream (see Kitchen notes) in a large bowl and beat until soft peaks form. Fold in half the passionfruit pulp.

Serve up: Cut the skin off half the pineapple, then halve again lengthwise and remove the core. Cut into 1cm-thick slices. Spoon the caramel into a 2L (8 cup) trifle bowl (see Kitchen notes). Top with most of the pineapple and drizzle with the remaining passionfruit. Top with the passionfruit cream and remaining pineapple and scatter over the nuts. Enjoy! Serves 4.

Kitchen notes: Chilling the cream for a couple of hours before using ensures it whips easily and holds its shape. ~ If you like, drizzle the caramel around the inside of the trifle bowl before layering the remaining ingredients.
